notes: The list marks starting cards inline: Coruscant and Coruscant: Imperial City '(SL)' (starting locations), one Prince Xizor '(x1 SC)', Prepared Defenses '(SI)', and three '(SE)' Effects (Mobilization Points, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order); they all count toward the 60. With three starting Effects, no single one is given as the starting effect.

Posted 'EJP Bossk' dested Bossk With Mortar Gun (Enhanced Jabba's Palace); 'ECC E-Lom' (typo) and 'ECC Iggy' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle and IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'EJP Dengar' dested Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'EPP Fett' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Prince Xixor' and 'Djahs Puhr' are misspellings of Prince Xizor and Djas Puhr.
Posted 'Coruscant Imperial City (SL)' and 'Crush the Rebellion (SE)' dested the printed cards, not the later (V) pages; 'Vibro Axe' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace Vibro-Ax.
'IAO (SE)' (Imperial Arrest Order) was missing from the machine draft and is restored; the posted Effects section counts 13.
'Grabber' is printed as written (the card is not named); Allegations Of Corruption (Coruscant, Aug 2001) did not yet exist.
Secret Plans was an Effect in 2001 (not yet a Defensive Shield).

The author's earlier version, 'Teching Agents of the Black Sun' (14559, 13 Mar 2001), is a different list (no Bossk With Mortar Gun, Ree-Yees, Main Course, Crush The Rebellion or Imperial Arrest Order there; it has Stinger, Dengar In Punishing One, Why Didn't You Tell Me? and others), so this is not a repost.
